Earlier scenes:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。他们在很漂亮的河找夹竹桃。神农问他的哥哥：“我应该吃这种植物吗？”哥哥说：“这就要看你想要安全还是接近知道了。“神农一吃夹竹桃就生病了。哥哥说：“太麻烦了。

This scene:
夹竹桃是毒的，我想知道灵芝会帮他。”哥哥给神农灵芝。神农吃完了以后开始痊愈了。神农说：“谢谢哥哥，你帮得真好。灵芝我们可以吃，特别是如果我们已经吃了夹竹桃。“

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 夹竹桃是毒的：有毒的
- 我想知道灵芝会帮他：灵芝有没有用/能不能帮他
- 哥哥给神农灵芝：给了，了completed
- 你帮得真好：你做得很好

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 夹竹桃是毒的：夹竹桃是有毒的，毒 is a noun here; use 有毒的 as the adjective phrase describing the plant. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他。”：他。，“” is a closing quotation mark, but this sentence has no opening quotation mark. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 夹竹桃。“：夹竹桃。”，The direct speech already begins with an opening quotation mark, so it must end with a closing quotation mark after the full stop. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 哥哥给神农灵芝：哥哥给了神农灵芝，Giving the lingzhi is a completed action in the event sequence, so the verb needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 毒 cannot directly serve as the adjective here; 有毒的 is correct.
The quotation is unmatched because there is no opening quotation mark, but the proposed replacement is not valid Chinese punctuation.
The full stop should be placed before the closing quotation mark in this direct speech.
Giving the lingzhi is a completed narrative event, so 给了 is required.
